Probability painting · SILHOUETTE

Probability painting · SILHOUETTE. Saved model response replay.

Reconstruct an entire 8×8 held-out canvas from saved pixel decisions. The canvas combines 64 saved typed decisions.

64 recorded silhouette decisions → 64 probability-mean RGB pixels.

One complete 8×8 test scene, chosen by minimum group ID; no correctness filtering. Pixels are derived only from saved model probabilities, not reference targets. Controlled geometry does not establish free-form artistic quality.

Evidence: https://github.com/Zefan-Cai/Open-Jev-Dev/blob/16ca7ee468e6754a7854cb9c1d7142cf7fa81d22/reports/full-data-eval-n1-v1/9b-audit.json
